Rule: exact-match criterion 1 (same class and category). cite.py --check 9.3.6 'are the same class and category' -> OK §9.3.6 1). The exact-vs-inexact distinction is consumed only by method-resolution steps 1-4 of §9.3.6 and the closing preference paragraph ('If two or more methods in a class match, preference is given to the method that has the greatest number of parameters that match exactly' - cite.py --check 9.3.6 OK), i.e. it SELECTS among two or more same-named candidates = parametric polymorphism (cite.py --check 9.3.5.3 'Parametric polymorphism is an optional feature' -> OK §9.3.5.3 7)). COBOL.NET does not claim it: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5 A.4.10 item 3 'NOT claimed' and §2 row 45 'N/A'; OoClassTable.Build refuses a second same-named method COBOLNET0822 (re-probed probe/ov.cob at --std 2023 -> 0822) and OoClassSymbol.FindMethod resolves by NAME alone. Along an inheritance chain a same-named method must be an OVERRIDE with the same signature (OoConformance, COBOLNET0829), so steps 1/2 and 3/4 always pick the same method and the criterion is unobservable. No derived selector covers the row (inventory-schema.json derived-verdicts.oo-optional-items-only deliberately excludes it; DerivedVerdictDriftTests.TheOoOptionalItemsSelector_IsStillSharp asserts that exclusion), and DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT is the owner's verdict (D13) -> NEEDS-OWNER-DECISION. Owning decision note: kb/Work PB1519 (open; batch 15d excluded exactly GR-9.3.6-L5.1..L5.3) - cited, not re-reported. OO method invocation is a COBOL-2002 introduction.

Rule: 'The New method allocates storage for an object, initializes its instance data in accordance with 14.6.2.4, Initial state of object data, and returns a reference to the created object.' (cite.py --check 16.2.1.2 -> OK §16.2.1.2 1)). §16.1 lets an implementation provide 'alternative root classes' (cite.py --check 16.1 'an implementation may provide alternative root classes' -> OK §16.1) and COBOL.NET's implicit root supplies a predefined NEW on every class: InvokeForm.New renders obj = new Class() (generated ctor chains base then VALUE-initializes), InvokeForm.NewSelf renders this.__New() for SELF|SUPER "NEW" in a factory (covariant, OoEmitter ~l.311/995), and class::"NEW" goes through OoBinder.InlineInvocation. VERIFIED (probe/new2.cob at --std 2002 and 2023): the returned reference is non-NULL; two NEWs yield independent storage (B1 mutated to 'XYZ 099', B2 still '--- 007'); object data takes its VALUE ('---', 007) and an OBJECT REFERENCE with no VALUE is NULL; pinned by conformance:2002/oo_instance_data (---/---/XYZ), oo_factory and pb428_inline_method_invocation exercise the NewSelf/inline forms. NOT VERIFIED / NOT REACHABLE: (1) the New of the standard BASE class itself - `CLASS-ID. X INHERITS FROM BASE` is refused COBOLNET0821 (re-probed probe/base1.cob at --std 2023), owned by kb/Work PB1506 (open; names this row as one its implementer claims); (2) the internal-file-connector and collating-sequence components of §14.6.2.4 for object data were not probed. Two halves, one verified -> PARTIAL. No new defect beyond PB1506.

Rule: 'If resources needed to create a new object are not available, the returned object reference is set to NULL, and the EC-OO-RESOURCE exception condition is set to exist and is propagated back to the runtime element that invoked the New method.' (cite.py --check 16.2.1.2 'the returned object reference is set to NULL, and the EC-OO-RESOURCE exception condition is set to exist' -> OK §16.2.1.2 2)). Code: EC-OO-RESOURCE exists only as a catalog entry (ExceptionCatalog.cs:171, L3 Fatal); grep over src finds NO raise site. NEW renders a bare C# `new Class()` / `__New() => new Class()` (BoundOo InvokeForm.New / OoEmitter ~l.314) with no OutOfMemoryException handler, so resource exhaustion escapes as an unhandled .NET exception instead of NULL + EC-OO-RESOURCE. The planned slice (docs/COBOLNET_OO_SLICE_BRIEFS.md l.248 'EC-OO (EC-OO-RESOURCE on New per §16.2.1 GR2 ...)') never landed. Contrast: CobolPtr.cs:211 already maps OutOfMemoryException to NULL + a condition for ALLOCATE - the precedent the fix should reuse. Not probed (resource exhaustion is not reproducible in a golden); decided by code reading. No kb/Work note owns EC-OO-RESOURCE (grep 'OO-RESOURCE' kb/Work -> none) - NEW finding, see findings.json 'ec-oo-resource-never-raised'. The BASE-class half is kb/Work PB1506's.

Rule: 'When invoked on an instance object, the FactoryObject method determines the class of the object and returns a reference to the factory object associated with that class.' (cite.py --check 16.2.2.2 -> OK §16.2.2.2 1)). The FactoryObject method belongs to BaseInterface (§16.2), the object interface of the standard BASE class, which is not provided: `INHERITS FROM BASE` is refused COBOLNET0821 (probe/base1.cob --std 2023), and no class carries a predefined FactoryObject - `INVOKE B1 "FactoryObject" RETURNING F1` (F1 USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE FACTORY OF BOX) is refused COBOLNET0825 'class BOX (and its inheritance chain) does not define an instance method named FactoryObject' at 2002/2014/2023 (probe/new1.cob). grep -ri FactoryObject over src/ and tests/ -> zero hits. The facility is absent -> NOT-IMPLEMENTED.
